      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "applied_energistics_2",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "With your first step on the Moon comes access to your first Certus Quartz vein.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Don't worry, they're quite common and should be easy to locate, though having a decent Ore Prospector wouldn't hurt.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Whether you decide to set up a miner or manually dig out a full vein, make sure to gather a hefty amount, as you'll need it to progress through AE2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "One small step for you, one giant leap for logistics",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:poor_raw_certus_quartz)item(gtceu:raw_certus_quartz)item(gtceu:rich_raw_certus_quartz))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Certus Quartz Ore",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Certus Quartz",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "One of your main resources for Applied Energistics 2 will be Charged Certus Quartz.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To obtain it, there’s really only one method: the HV Polarizer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll quickly notice how long this recipe takes, so it’s strongly recommended to dedicate a Polarizer exclusively to this task.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "It may seem expensive or daunting at first, but don't worry—it’s absolutely worth it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Also, remember not to charge all your Certus Quartz!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll need some uncharged ones for items like the Annihilation Core, so always keep a small reserve on hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Redstone isn't enough",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Sifter is used for ore processing to increase your yield of Certus Quartz, Quartzite, Nether Quartz, Ruby, and Armalcolite—all of which are essential for AE2. Alternatively, you can smelt the ores directly in a Furnace if you're in a rush, but you'll lose out on a lot of free resources by doing that.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The second machine, the Mixer, is your only method to create Fluix Crystals (more about that in the next quest). Don’t forget that you can also use the Greate Mixer as a HS-tier machine.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Thirdly, a Laser Engraver can combine lesser quality gems together into Exquisite, which will give you better Fluix yields.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Lastly, keep in mind that an Autoclave can help you generate even more gems from dusts. Once you have the resources, crafting one will make your life significantly easier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Or is it four?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:hv_mixer)item(greate:stainless_steel_mechanical_mixer))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Greate or GregTech?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(vintageimprovements:vibrating_table)item(gtceu:lv_sifter)item(gtceu:mv_sifter)item(gtceu:hv_sifter)item(gtceu:ev_sifter)item(gtceu:iv_sifter)item(gtceu:luv_sifter)item(gtceu:zpm_sifter)item(gtceu:uv_sifter))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Sifter",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Three Musketeers",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "As you can see, there are multiple ways to create Fluix Crystals using a Mixer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The higher the purity of your input gems, the better the yield — that’s exactly why we recommended crafting a Sifter earlier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll need a massive amount of Fluix Crystals, especially since the liquid version is used in most Applied Energistics 2 recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "So prepare yourself—you’re going to need a lot!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Energetic Crystal",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Most of your Fluix Crystals will be converted into Liquid Fluix.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "However, make sure to keep a few in their crystal form for the occasional recipe that specifically requires it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Extractor will do the job here — no need for anything fancy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The precious fluix",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:lv_extractor)item(gtceu:mv_extractor)item(gtceu:hv_extractor)item(gtceu:ev_extractor))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Extractor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Fluid Extractor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We told you you'd need a vast quantity of Liquid Fluix… but we didn’t mention there’s a way to drastically increase your yield per Fluix Crystal.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Introducing: Cryogenized Fluix, an ultra-cold fluid only craftable on the Moon using a Vacuum Freezer. Simply combine Liquid Fluix with Helium-3!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This special fluid can be used as a substitute in nearly all recipes that require Liquid Fluix—but only when you're crafting on the Moon.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Moon-based AE2 recipes come with huge benefits: reduced energy costs, less components needed, or sometimes both! Investing in a proper Moon base for AE2 production will pay off massively, especially in early game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "It’s not strictly mandatory — yet. But setting up a second base now will ease your future progression, as planet-based infrastructure becomes essential later on. So… why not get ahead of the curve?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Moon is so cheap",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Liquid Fluix",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Here you are, ready to begin your AE2 infrastructure!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This chapter will mainly guide you through what you can and cannot craft yet.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We’ll also highlight the most important items you should focus on.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "However, to fully understand Applied Energistics 2, we strongly recommend using the G keybind (similar to Create's Ponder system) or open the ME Guide we provide as a reward from this quest. It’s the best in-game tutorial for AE2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Alternatively, watch some online videos about AE2 on 1.20.1 for more detailed explanations — AE2 is a very popular mod, so there's a ton of tutorials out there!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Pro tip: Many AE2 recipes have alternative Moon recipes that are much cheaper. Once again, investing in your Moon base will greatly reward you throughout the entire game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Another free book for your collection!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to AE2",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To get started, you’ll need to power your ME Network. These are the two AE2 blocks that can directly accept EU energy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We strongly recommend crafting a ME Controller, as channels are enabled in TerraFirmaGreg, and the ME Controller is the best way to manage multiple channels efficiently.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This is also a great time to use the in-game guide (press U on a ME Controller) or watch some videos about AE2 on version 1.20.1 to learn more!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The beating heart of your ME network",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To get the printed circuits, you'll need to craft the HV Forming Press.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The good news? It has multiple input slots, meaning you can insert all your circuit presses at once, so a single Forming Press is enough to handle every printed circuit type.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Small is good too",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Forming Press",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "One of the last things you’ll need before diving fully into Applied Energistics 2 is collecting the 4 Presses.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To obtain them, you must locate an AE2 Meteorite on the Moon — they will look like dark spheres at the bottom of large craters. Luckily, they aren't particularly rare, and a single meteorite will contain all four Presses.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Be careful though — these meteorites are often guarded, so gear up, bring an ore prospector if you have one, and happy hunting!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Treasure hunt",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": []
    },

        {

        },

        {

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/chemical_elements.snbt",
          "text": "Beryllium is widely used for nuclear fission, including fissile fuel rods, Heat Batteries, and fuels such as FLiBe. It is also used in HV to create Ender Dust.",

          "text": "Boron is a component of borosilicate glass used in MV+ to make gem lenses and in HV+ to make AE2 cables, Vitrified Ender Pearls, and Fiber-Reinforced Circuit Boards.",

        },

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You’ve built new chemistry lines, manufactured advanced alloys, and even launched a Rocket to reach the Moon. We hope you enjoyed the ride, because now things get even more complex, with powerful new machines and demanding processes ahead.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "In the EV Chapter, your main objective will be to craft your very first IV and LuV Circuits.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Along the way, several key challenges await you:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Build your first Alloy Blast Smelter, a faster version of the EBF, specialized for alloys. With it, you’ll be able to construct your first Large Machine: the Large Centrifuge, essential for the Nuclear Fission Line. It also lets you upgrade ore processing with a faster Thermal Centrifuge.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Master our original Tungsten Line - looping all the required materials will test both your knowledge and your patience.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Prepare to fly to Mars where you’ll become an extraterrestrial farmer while also learning to harness the power of the atom.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Good luck, this is where GregTech begins to show its true depth!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Let's go Nuclear on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This is Extreme Voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This new rocket shouldn’t be too difficult to assemble, but you’ll notice a clear jump in material costs compared to your previous model.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The upgraded Rocket Alloys now require both Distilled Water and Cryogenized Fluix for cooling.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Make sure you've fully set up your Titanium production line, as you're going to need a lot of it going forward! A continuous production line will save you a lot of frustration down the road.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This one's purple",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(ad_astra:tier_2_rocket)item(tfg:tier_2_double_rocket))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Either rocket",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Rocket 2: Titanium Boogaloo",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "First, like the Moon, Mars will have some hostile surface mobs as well. If you haven't already figured out how to make your Space Suit stay with you after dying or invested in new EV-tier weaponry, you'll have a rough time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The planet is mostly a desert world, dotted with \"islands\" where you’ll find water, lush fauna, and much safer places to build your first base. Meanwhile, the open desert is extremely dangerous if you don't watch your step, but contains some other crucial resources!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "All fluid veins are spread across Mars, except for Heavy Ammoniacial Water which can only be found outside of the desert. That’s another good reason to set up your base there.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Energy-wise, Mars will not be kind to you at first.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Nearly every common energy generation method is disabled or worthless on the planet, which means you’ll have to rely almost entirely on Fission to power your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At the very beginning, we recommend bringing along some filled batteries such as Lapotron Crystals to get started, and then look towards setting up Thorium Fuel Rods.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Achieving energy stability on Mars will take time and effort, but once your systems are running smoothly, you’ll feel like unlimited power is right in the palm of your hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "And one last tip: don’t kill everything you see. Some animals can be ranched, and you’ll definitely need them later in your progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Be sure to check out the Space Survival chapter for more Mars-related tips too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Stay alert, plan ahead, and Mars will reward your courage.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Red Planet",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Land on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I'm on Mars!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Congrats on making your first Tungsten! We hope you enjoy this small increase in complexity. Remember that, at first, the small amount of Tungsten you require can be achieved by simply inputting the Soda Ash you mined. This may inspire you to fully loop the process so you can automate it peacefully.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Also remember that the further you progress, the more important it will be to build dedicated and passive lines for all these complex processes that will be required until the end of the pack. Don’t be afraid of lacking resources, be afraid of lacking time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fully self-sustaining, just like Titanium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Tungsten Line in TerraFirmaGreg has been completely reworked and you’ll be happy (or not) to know that it’s now much harder.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It’s possible to fully loop every material in the Tungsten Line, but doing so requires a lot of engineering. Alternatively, you can brute-force your way through by mass-producing the resources you need.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A little tip: Mars has several good ore veins for Soda Ash and Tungsten.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Take your time, optimize, and the Tungsten Line will become the foundation of your mid-to-late game progress.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Why? Just why?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The new Tungsten Line",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "all_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You know what to do with this by now, but this is a good time to give you a heads up that now is the time to scale up your factory if you haven't already done so.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Take your time to set up AE2 all over your base, making it print you dozens of new machines to keep your factory running at tip-top shape, because if you don't, the rest of EV is going to hit you like a brick wall.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't wait to find out the hard way!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At the very least, here's what we recommend before pushing further into EV:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Passive production of Rubber, Polyethylene, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, and Chlorine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- At least two general-purpose EBFs, and a few LCRs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",

        },
        {

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Distillation Tower (DT) is a direct multiblock upgrade of the Distillery. You won't have to choose outputs any more as the DT will handle them all automatically, at an increased power cost.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This machine will be your future bread and butter for anything involving Petrochem or Organic distillation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Like the Cleanroom, the DT can be made taller, though not wider. Starting from the second layer, each added level requires an Output Hatch and grants one additional fluid output slot; if a level lacks its output hatch, the corresponding fluid will be voided. Count the number of outputs with EMI so you know how many layers you need. As always, use the Multiblock Preview tab in EMI and click the multiblock to see where you can place each part.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: Be careful not to over-overclock the DT when producing fuels! Excessive overclocking can reduce the overall power yield, especially for Diesel. Do the math and double-check your calculations.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Mr. President, another Distillation Tower has hit the factory floor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Distillation Tower",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Epoxy is the foundation for all future Circuit Boards in the game!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: This Quest is quite complicated, so tackle everything else before trying to make Epoxy. You'll need all the help you can get!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "There are several ways to obtain the ingredients for Epoxy.",

          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }

        {

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You now have access to two new Maintenance Hatches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Automatic Maintenance Hatch is pretty simple - it eliminates the need for Maintenance, forever.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Configurable Maintenance Hatch is more interesting. You can configure it to cut off 10%% duration on recipes, at the cost of making Maintenance happen three times as fast. That is 16 real hours of activity. Additionally, you can use it on Multiblock Generators to increase the duration of the recipe, which indirectly increases their fuel efficiency by 10%%!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Reminder: You can put Tape in the maintenance Hatch to automatically fix problems.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: The Automatic Maintenance Hatch texture and mechanic comes from TecTech, an addon mod originally made for GregTech: New Horizons.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You'll see more from TecTech if you stick with us with the late game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I have become maintenance, eater of tape",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced Maintenance",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Just like MV, you'll need to make higher-tier components.",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The painful Flawless Gems have been replaced with slightly-more-painful Vitrified Ender Pearls. Also notice that the Motors require 2x Silver Cables.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hulls and Machines use Gold Cables.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Finally, a use for that stockpile of Gold!",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tips to make life less painful:",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",

        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use Electrotine decomposition and Ore Processing for Electrum.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use the Chemical Bath with Mercury for Gold and Silver from a wide variety of ores.",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We call this \"fun\"",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Components",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Assembler is the next step in progression, but also unlocks a handful of useful utilities - check around this quest for more.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this HV Assembler to make your Rocket.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Assembler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You'll want to grab these two lenses. The Simple System on Chip will be used for the best ULV Circuit recipe, while the LPIC Wafer is required for your next Energy Hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I see the world in colour",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "ULV Circuits are used in some AE2 recipes and Create recipes.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Best ULV circuits!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Low Power Integrated Circuit requires an HV Cutter inside your Cleanroom.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Energy Hatches will be nice additions so you can run your Multiblocks (mainly your Electric Blast Furnace and Large Chemical Reactor) directly off a HV line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Noticing a pattern here?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Upgrade your EBF II",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Chemical Reactor unlocks a ton of new recipes. Ah, who doesn't love the ever-growing demand on more advanced Chemistry?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: We've actually unlocked a ton of new content by reaching HV. However, not every processing line or item is crucial right now. It'd make the HV chapter far too dense if we included everything!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You could still check out the EV Chapter if you want to push yourself.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Chemistry",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium requires a slightly more involved process than the previous materials to process. To get started, you'll need Rutile, which can be obtained by processing Ilmenite that you can get from Bauxite, Aluminium, Armalcolite and Desh, which can be found in massive quantities on The Moon.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once you've gotten enough Rutile, your journey to Titanium continues in the next quest. There's no need to rush things.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tip: Ore processing for Bauxite is ridiculously good! It can easily triples your Rutile yield.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "...means it WASN'T Titanium!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Almost Titanium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To get your grubby hands on some Titanium, Rutile must first be reduced to Titanium Tetrachloride in an HV Chemical Reactor, then reduced again in an EBF with Magnesium to finally arrive at Titanium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Carbon, Chlorine, Oxygen, and Magnesium used in the process can be perfectly recovered from the byproduct Carbon Monoxide and Magnesium Chloride with no loss. If you set up a system to recover them, the only material that you'll need to provide for Titanium is Rutile!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium Tetrachloride also acts as a catalyst in the production of plastics. A touch of TiCl₄ in the polymerisation process can increase the polymer yield to 133%%. Naturally, this is completely optional.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Is it titanium yet?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Click here to complete this quest/task",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Almost Titanium²",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "By this point, normal Cables have such insignificant loss that superconductors aren't a requirement. That being said, they're still useful for being able to split and combine cables on the fly, and these ones are half oxygen so they're cheap too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Superconductors are still required to craft Field Generators.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Superconductors",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Nichrome Heating Coils increase the temperature of your Blast Furnace to 3,600K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "These will be required to upgrade your primary EBF so you can make Titanium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In the original GregTech 5, there were only three types of coils. This was the last tier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A long way to go before we beat the Sun",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Nichrome Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium has the highest corrosion resistance and strength-to-density ratio of any metallic element, so it's only natural that we'll be using it as the main material in our EV machinery.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": []
    },

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
