          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This Superconductor will be required for progression during LuV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "IV Superconductors",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you already made and centrifuged Rare Earth, that's great! If you haven't, you can obtain it as a Byproduct from various ores, or from centrifuging Monazite.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To extract the Rare Earths, you should use a Centrifuge as high a tier as possible, due to the increased chance of bonus outputs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The elements you can obtain are:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Lanthanum is used in Fusion - you will eventually want a lot of it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Yttrium is used in Yttrium-Barium-Cuprate-Oxide (YBCO), a wire material for UV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Cerium is not particularly useful.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Samarium is used for IV Superconductors and Magnetic Rods for LuV+ Motors.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Neodymium normally makes the strongest magnets, but gameplay balance... y'know.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Cadmium is not particularly useful.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Rare Earth Elements (REE) contain a lot more metals than these, but we're struggling as is to give them use.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Rare Earth",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-G Coils bring up the Heat Capacity to 5,400K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The ever-tempting Coil bonuses should be high incentive to make those early, as they become mandatory only during LuV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At this point, you may go back to using only one Electric Blast Furnace for your entire base, powering with the highest available Voltage you have.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hot Metals will start taking longer to cool down, as the Vacuum Freezer doesn't get perfect overclocks. For that, you probably want a dual (or quad) Vacuum Freezer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Approaching solar temperatures",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-G Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High-Speed Steels (HSS) are more resistant Steel Alloys typically used in Rails.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you previously made Ultimet for whatever reason, you've already acquired Molybdenum. Otherwise, it can be found in a Nether vein.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We hope you have a lot of Tungstensteel, because you're still gonna need more! It's used for the creation of HSS alloys - in this case, HSS-G.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-G",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Technically, HSS-E doesn't contain Manganese, but some other HSS alloys do have Manganese, so... close enough?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-E has some niche uses in progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This alloy has great durability and damage property for tools. It has the best Power multiplier (until Neutronium!) as a Rotor for Large Turbines, though it's slightly less efficient than HSS-S.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-E",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When running the Extreme Combustion Engine, you're gonna want to boost it! Why bother otherwise?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Get yourself a 4A IV Dynamo Hatch as the output, and one Vacuum Freezer for Liquid Oxygen.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You should now be wielding the equivalent of 1 LuV Amp, all whilst burning fuel at 200% efficiency!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget to keep it supplied with a small amount of Lubricant.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The ECE is also void-free, unlike Large Turbines. Any energy that cannot be output will momentarily pause the multiblock.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: The ECE comes from GT:NH. However... its implementation wasn't so rosy at first. The stats on the tooltip looked similar to this one - so far, so good.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The bad part came when crunching the numbers. Players ended up realizing they needed to run around 16 whole HV Vacuum Freezers to keep up with the Liquid Oxygen demand...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The one and only fuel it would accept is High Octane Gasoline, which was stated to be burned at 300% efficiency when boosted, but the UI was lying. The efficiency remained at 100%.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The GT:NH team eventually decided to rework the ECE among other power options... phew!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The ultimate Combustion generator!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Extreme Combustion Engine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You should have all the tools available to produce Polybenzimidazole on your own!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "PBI only becomes mandatory to progress from LuV to ZPM, but tackling it earlier will unlock the Advanced SMDs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "GTCEu's toughest polymer!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Better SMDs to make far more complex Circuits at a much cheaper price.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "These'll require Alloys that you have not made yet, most of which will be common in LuV and onwards.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced SMDs are required for the Crystal Circuit line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced SMDs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tungstensteel under your belt? Nanoprocessor Mainframes on demand? Let's make some machinery.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The IV Assembler is required to unlock IV Energy and Dynamo Hatches, as well as HSS-G Coils.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Upgrading this to its GCYM variant isn't a bad idea.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Did you know that GTCE's content stopped at EV, and all content up to UV was provided by Shadows of Greg, a third party mod?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "IV Assembler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Large Tungstensteel Boiler is the final Steam Boiler. It's even more efficient than the previous ones, and produces more steam.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This thing is a colossal noob trap, and you should ABSOLUTELY use something else. Don't make this, it's not good, not even as a meme! Steam doesn't scale beyond this point, and this boiler will likely be removed in the future.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: This quest can be skipped (for completion progress) by clicking the Checkmark. You do not have to actually craft one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: No one makes these in GT5u either... y'know, almost makes you feel sorry for the poor boiler.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Good luck fueling this, lmao",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Worst Combustion",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Laminated Glass is the shiny new tier of Glass for IV and onwards. It is made in the Forming Press using a new Polymer: Polyvinyl Butyral.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "None of the steps should be particularly difficult if you already have the Distillation Tower for Cracked Fuels, and you have also automated Epoxy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you don't already have both set up, you know what to do!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: Polyvinyl Acetate (required for the Glass) can also be used for Glue!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Laminated Glass",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-S is another completely fictional High Speed Steel, alloyed with Iridium and Osmium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The UHPIC unlocks ZPM Energy Hatches and Dynamos, as well as the Active Transformer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You may know the drill, but do you know the screwdriver?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ultra High Power Integrated Circuit",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Dielectric PCB Coolant is used to maintain some highly advanced late and end-game machinery.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You only need a little bit in LuV, but you'll want to automate it when you get to ZPM.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Absolutely beneficial for the environment",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Dielectric PCB Coolant",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Active Transformer is a multiblock used to transform energy on a much larger scale. For example, you can convert HV to LV power directly by using the apropriate energy hatches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It also has a second function, detailed in the above quest.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: This is yet another feature from TecTech, which also required these cables to be painted. They do look fantastic if you paint them, but it's optional in CEu.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "More than a large transformer",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Active Transformer",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Data Bank is a multiblock capable of storing huge amounts of data. You can fill it with Data Access Hatches, and fill those with Data Storage Items.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "After that, you'll need power, and then a way to connect it to your Assembly Line! This is done through Optical Fiber Cables, which can be used to link Optical Data Hatches together.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "An Optical Transmission Hatch is used to send data (like an output), and an Optical Reception Hatch to recieve the data (like an input).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Optical cables have some restrictions however. They can only connect one input to one output. The Data Bank is your answer to this, since you can place many hatches on them to route your data anywhere.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You can use this behavior to chain Data Banks as well. Connecting one Data Bank to another, and then one of them to an Assembly Line will provide the data of both banks!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: This multiblock will be required later on in progression, but is very useful to set up early.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: This multiblock also originates from TecTech, but part of its mechanics required optical cables to be painted as well. You don't have to do that here, but it looks really nice if you do!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Time for a server room",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Mass Data Storage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Active Transformer has a second use - Laser Power. Lasers are like superconductors, but behave slightly differently. They share the energy input across all connected active transformers, allowing widespread power distribution. You can use Active Transformers to convert regular EU to and from Lasers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Like optical cables, they can only be connected to one input and output. But, these ones also only can move in straight lines. To turn them, an Active Transformer with a Laser Source Hatch (output) and Target Hatch (input) is needed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: This is yet again another TecTech feature, but there's a bit more to it this time. TecTech's lasers were tiered by voltage and carried thousands of amps instead. CEu doesn't faff around with any of that tiering. You only need one type of laser here!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Time for some lasers!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Laser Power Transmission",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Doping Silicon with Naquadah will give a better Silicon Boule.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Use it for higher yield on Wafers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This will also unlock the best recipe for HV Circuits in the LuV Circuit Assembler. You're probably going to want to mass produce these for the many Lapotronic Energy Orbs that'll be required moving forwards.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Doper than ever before",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah-doped Silicon Boule",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah is a late-game material with a variety of uses. It is required when building a Fusion Reactor and progressing to ZPM, to name a few.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "For some reason, its fluid is a brilliant green - don't ask us why.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Naquadah is a material originally from Stargate.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't you mean Stargatium?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah Coils crank up the Heat Capacity to 7,200K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "These coils are required for progressing to the second half of LuV and beyond.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Well... not some \"juicy GregTech lore\", but a cool space fact, owing to the fact you're beating the Sun's temperature with your EBF. The surface temperature of the Sun is 5,800K. We're taking this as an effective temperature - i.e. the radiative temperature of the Sun as if it were a perfectly \"black body\". Check out the Stefan-Boltzmann law if you're interested in some crude astrophysics.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Oh, and the \"photosphere\" (the part of the sun we're talking about when we mention its surface)? It's 400 kilometres thick. That's 250 miles. Damn!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hotter than the surface temperature of the Sun!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LuV Superconductors are necessary if you're eyeing a Fusion Reactor.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't ignore our warning here - you're gonna need a lot of them. Luckily, any Indium shortages will be solved by your Naquadah line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Be glad these don't use pumps",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LuV Superconductors",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Warning: Plasmas are extremely hot, with temperatures exceeding 30k Kelvin!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "However, this doesn't mean that a special type of pipe is required to transport plasma. Plasmas are treated slightly differently, and bend the rules a bit.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fluid pipes that can handle plasmas, such as Tungsten, Naquadah, or Duranium can hold any plasma regardless of temperature. This means they won't melt under the heat of the plasma!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "WARNING: Plasmas in incompatible pipes will cause voiding, pipe burning, and disproportionately high rates of death. Be careful!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: This mechanic originates from GT6, just like the acids!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The stars are calling...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fluid of the Stars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Use this turbine to extract very large amounts of power from plasma!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Helium Plasma is the best fuel for its cost.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you're the type to question how realistic Plasma Turbines are... look up Magnetohydrodynamic Generators if you want something that bends fact into fiction.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Plasma? Turbine?! How?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Large Plasma Turbine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This is the main material for ZPM. Having this in stock will be a test of your Platinum processing, so this is a pre-emptive warning to stay on top of mining PGS-bearing ore.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Prepare to make lots... after you make Fusion and Crystal Circuits. Tackle those before you try making this.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Stargate's Strongest",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah Alloy",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Refining Naquadah into further products will be your next automation challenge. The primary outputs of this line are Enriched Naquadah, Naquadria, and Trinium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": []
    },

        {

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Fluid Regulator is sort of the equivalent to a Robot Arm for Fluids.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It can transfer fluids, but has two useful modes:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Supply Exact will transfer the amount of specified Fluid per tick if available. No more, no less.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Keep Exact will make sure the exact amount of Fluid in the attached machine is being kept.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You won't need it much, because natively GT machines will fill only one slot with the Pump Cover",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A cover that you may not use much",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Fluid Regulator",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When placed on a machine, Robot Arms are a more configurable version of a Conveyor Module. They allow you to transfer items in specific batches, at specific rates, or keep a certain amount of items stocked.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Practical uses for the Robot Arm will be explained in future Quests as a tutorial.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: The functionalities provided by the Robot Arm work only if it is required to perform the operation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: GregTech 5 had blocks such as the Buffer, Filter and Type Filter to allow fine control over items. In GTCE it's all been replaced by the almighty Robot Arm and various Filter Covers. Much more compact!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You're going to hate making these",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Robot Arm",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Less common as a component, but used in a number of critical machines.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When placed on a machine, conveyor modules will transfer items. You can configure them to import or export.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "They can also accept various Item Filters.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A crafting component, but also a cover!",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Steam Turbine is most players' first LV generator, as you've already got steam production set up from your Steam machines.",

          "item_ref_count": 32

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When provided Steam, the turbine will output EU at a ratio of 2 mB = 1 EU.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "One downside of steam is transporting it, and due to its lack of energy density, you'll need large or huge pipes to carry it around.",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You may also consider upgrading to the Large Bronze Boiler once you start needing more power than what your single-block boilers can produce.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Steam Turbine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This questline serves as a quick guide to GregTech Amperage. As for Voltage mechanics, we'll go over those once you reach MV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "TL;DR: For safety, match the Amperage limit of your Cables with the max amount of Amps provided by your Energy Producers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Still confused? Check the GregTech Energy chapter for a full rundown on GregTech's electricity system!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "But what are Amps?",

          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Well... can you show us an MV Circuit as well?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Aluminium is the main ingredient for MV machinery. Get ready to need a lot of it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The process of smelting Aluminium can be cut down by about a third with Nitrogen, which is obtained by centrifuging Air from a Gas Collector.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will still need MV Circuits in order to make MV machines!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We're basically in MV now, right?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Your first Aluminium Ingot",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Make some Battery Alloy, used for Battery Hulls.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Antimony is found in Stibnite, look through your TFC Field Guide for more information on where to find it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",

          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Batteries are great!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Battery Preparations!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Covers are placed by right-clicking with Cover in hand on a face of a machine, and removed with a Crowbar (or by mining the machine, but that's way slower).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Pretty much any GregTech Tile-Entity will accept Covers, even if they wouldn't provide any functionality.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Opening a Cover is done by sneak-right-clicking it with an empty hand. You can also right-click with a Screwdriver, or sneak-right-click on another face using the grid.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "For Covers that transfer Items/Fluids, you will have a button to enable/disable other forms of transfer through the cover:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Disabled: only the cover will be allowed to transfer on this machine side.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Allow Filtered (only relevant with a filter!): other transfer will be enabled only if it matches the filter",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Allow Unfiltered: any other transfer is allowed on this machine side.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Placing a cover of a lower voltage tier on a machine is safe.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Extra utility without taking up blockspace!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I'm an expert on Covers now, don't you worry.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Cover Behaviour",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "All machines typically have one Front Face, and one Output Face.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Front Face should be obvious.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Output Face is the face with a dot or hole on it. By default, this is at the back of the machine as you place it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }

        {
