          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "They use lots of Osmiridium, so make sure your platinum refining process is up to the task.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Prepare your platline!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Absolute Elation",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Enriched Naquadah is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-528. It is radioactive and will be used in (as of yet) unimplemented nuclear reactors.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Currently, you just need it to make Trinium Coils.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah, but radioactive!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Enriched Naquadah",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Trinium Coils bring up the Heat Capacity to 9,001K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "These coils are required for progressing to the second half of ZPM, and beyond.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "IT'S OVER 9000!!!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Trinium Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Research Station is the upgrade to the Scanner. It's used for more advanced forms of research, and will finally allow you to perform research which requires Data Orbs and Modules.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When running the Research Station, energy and Computation is needed. The latter is provided through an HPCA, which is explained in the next quest. It is recieved with a Computation Data Reception Hatch. Note that only one Reception Hatch is allowed in a Research Station.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This multiblock needs computation sporadically, which means the recipe will not reverse progress if you don't supply enough - it will simply halt in-place. However, the machine will still draw energy constantly, even when recieving no computation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "To scan items, the process is relatively similar. In the Object Holder, place the target item in the center slot, and the data storage item in the other slot. Then provide computation, and the data storage item will be updated upon completion. When running, the target item will be Locked and cannot be removed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Note: To form this multiblock, the Object Holder must face the controller.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Your research adventures continue!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Research Station",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The UV Mainframe is required to move into Fusion Mk2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "It's also made in the Assembly Line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Passing over the ingredients we've already seen before, watch out for the HSS-E Frames.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "...ah, here we go!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "First UV Circuits!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Crystal SoC is used to make cheaper Crystal Circuits. Enjoy the discount!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Crystal SoCs require ZPM Emitters, which means you need a Data Orb for their research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "In the future, these may become more difficult to make.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In GT5u, the texture for this item was red, and did not have the special design on it. There was a \"raw\" version with the design, but it was used for other unrelated things. Who knows why?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When engraving it once isn't enough",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Crystal SoC",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This hatch allows you to store more Data Storage Items than the basic one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget that this hatch requires a Data Orb for research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Increased storage density!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced Data Access Hatch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadria is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-522. It's highly unstable, but it'll still be used for UV components, Fusion Mk2, and when fusing Neutronium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah, but radioactive-er!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Production of Sterilized Growth Medium is the final processing line in GTCEu, for now.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this for your first Wetware Circuits.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Producing it won't be as much of a hassle as PBI, but nearly every step requires a Sterilized Cleanroom. This means you'll have to get creative with how you use your space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Make sure to scrutinise every step of the chain. Some recipes are much more efficient than others!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Pro Tip: You can wall-share cleanrooms with doors in-between too if you want more space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: GTCEu's Sterilized Growth Medium chain is loosely based off of Bartworks' from GTNH. The main difference is that GTNH required a Bacterial Vat multiblock, which was more complex than the ordered Assembly Line. GTCEu is considering adding a multiblock like it but with their own spin in the future.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "More Lore: In Gregicality Legacy, the Sterilized Growth Medium production chain was very different. It was one of the most difficult processes in the mod, with over 30 complicated steps! It was based off of producing different real-life vitamins and nutrients.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Even More Lore: In Shadows of Greg, this was made with just Distilled Water and Mince Meat. How far we've come...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The final processing line, at last!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Sterilized Growth Medium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The ZPM Lapotronic Orb is even better than the LuV one! It of course comes at a price...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Imagine making 64 IV or 8 LuV Orbs for just one of these! See the Lore for the LuV orb for details.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "A power singularity!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Mega Batteries",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This Quest will be completed with either a ZPM Energy Hatch... or a ZPM Dynamo Hatch for your Multiblock Generators.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget that 16 Amp variants exist!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],

          "text": "The Jet Suit is an upgraded version of the Netherite Space Suit, with more protection, additional oxygen storage, and flight. It's expensive to craft, but it offers high-speed flight, making travel easy.",

          "label": "Jet Suit",

          "text": "It's got two modes of flight: ascending () and boosted ( + ). Ascending makes the wearer fly upwards, while boosted is similar to an elytra that's constantly being propelled by fireworks. The Jet Suit is powered by energy and must be charged to fly.       "id": "tfc:blast/off",

      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "advancement",
          "id": "tfc:story/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!data/tfc/advancements/story/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Blast off!",
          "key": "advancement-title:title",
          "label": "Blast off!",
          "item_ref_count": 1
        },
        {
          "kind": "advancement",
          "id": "tfc:story/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!data/tfc/advancements/story/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Craft a blast furnace",
          "key": "advancement-description:description",
          "label": "Blast off!",
          "item_ref_count": 1
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "A Blast Furnace is an advanced device which is used in the creation of Steel. By mixing Iron Ores, Coke or Anthacite, and Flux in a controlled, hot environment, you can create a stronger metal than cast or wrought iron. To obtain a blast furnace, you will first need a Crucible and a lot of Wrought Iron Plates.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Crafting a blast furnace itself requires a Crucible, along with some of the Double Wrought Iron Plates you will need.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "You will then need to construct the blast furnace, along with its Chimney. The chimney must be composed out of Reinforced Fire Bricks, as they are strong enough to withstand the intense heat. These can be crafted from fire brick blocks, and either cast iron or wrought iron plates. The plates can be applied to each exposed face of the bricks by + with the plate in hand, or crafted into Blast Furnace Insulation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "A Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.name",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "A blast furnace with a minimum height chimney.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "The blast furnace's chimney can be up to five layers - each layer requiring four Fire Bricks and twelve Wrought Iron Plates to complete. Having more layers increases the total capacity of the blast furnace, allowing it to smelt more steel at once. Each chimney layer, up to a maximum of five, allows the blast furnace to hold four additional ore items.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "In order to use the blast furnace, you must drop items in the top of the chimney - for steel production, you must add an equal number of items of Iron Ores and Flux. Any iron ores or items that are able to melt into Cast Iron will do. You will also need to add Coke or Anthacite, which will be consumed as the blast furnace works.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Using the blast furnace will open the blast furnace interface, seen to the right. In this interface, you will see meters for both ore and fuel contents of the blast furnace. The top right slot must have a Tuyere, which is a metal pipe used to funnel air into the blast furnace, required to reach the hottest temperatures to smelt steel. A tuyere can be smithed on an Anvil.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "The Blast Furnace Interface",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "You will also need a Bellows in order for the Blast Furnace to reach a temperature which will melt iron. This can be placed on any of the four sides of the blast furnace.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "A full size blast furnace with bellows and crucible attached.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Finally, to get started, light the blast furnace with a Fire Starter or a Flint and Steel. It will begin to heat the ores inside. Make sure that the blast furnace continues to have fuel, and use the bellows to add air to the blast furnace after its internal temperature has reached the maximum for charcoal. After the ores inside heat up, they will melt and convert into Pig Iron.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "This liquid metal will drip into any metal fluid container placed immediately below the blast furnace, such as a Crucible. It can be cast into ingot molds from the output slot of the crucible and worked into Steel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "A Blast Furnace is an advanced device which is used in the creation of Steel. By mixing Iron Ores, Charcoal, and Flux in a controlled, hot environment, you can create a stronger metal than cast or wrought iron. To obtain a blast furnace, you will first need a Crucible and a lot of Wrought Iron Sheets.",

          "text": "You will then need to construct the blast furnace, along with its Chimney. The chimney must be composed out of Fire Bricks, as they are strong enough to withstand the intense heat.           "label": "Blast Furnace",

          "text": "A Blast Furnace",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.name",

          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {

          "text": "A blast furnace with a minimum height chimney.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "The blast furnace's chimney can be up to five layers - each layer requiring four Fire Bricks and twelve Wrought Iron Sheets to complete. Having more layers increases the total capacity of the blast furnace, allowing it to smelt more steel at once. Each chimney layer, up to a maximum of five, allows the blast furnace to hold four additional ore items.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "In order to use the blast furnace, you must drop items in the top of the chimney - for steel production, you must add an equal number of items of Iron Ores and Flux. Any iron ores or items that are able to melt into Cast Iron will do. You will also need to add Charcoal, which will be consumed as the blast furnace works.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Using the blast furnace will open the blast furnace interface, seen to the right. In this interface, you will see meters for both ore and fuel contents of the blast furnace. The top right slot must have a Tuyere, which is a metal pipe used to funnel air into the blast furnace, required to reach the hottest temperatures to smelt steel. A tuyere can be smithed on an Anvil.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "The Blast Furnace Interface",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "You will also need a Bellows in order for the Blast Furnace to reach a temperature which will melt iron. This can be placed on any of the four sides of the blast furnace.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "A full size blast furnace with bellows and crucible attached.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "Finally, to get started, light the blast furnace with a Fire Starter or a Flint and Steel. It will begin to heat the ores inside. Make sure that the blast furnace continues to have fuel, and use the bellows to add air to the blast furnace after its internal temperature has reached the maximum for charcoal. After the ores inside heat up, they will melt and convert into Pig Iron.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/blast_furnace.json",
          "text": "This liquid metal will drip into any metal fluid container placed immediately below the blast furnace, such as a Crucible. It can be cast into ingot molds from the output slot of the crucible and worked into Steel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "TerraFirmaCraft Blast Furnace Tips",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "So, you finally found that Kaolinite and are probably feeling pretty excited about making a 5-level Blast Furnace. Here are some tips before you go wild!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "Before you use all your fire clay on 20 fire bricks, note that once you get into the steam age, you can craft it for significantly cheaper. This allows you to save Kaolinite and Graphite for Casting Tables.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "Preheating Metal",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "To convert the iron to steel, the blast furnace must heat the iron inside to Brilliant White. On the first operation, the metal warms up along with the blast furnace. However, subsequent operations will take a similar amount of time despite the furnace being at temp already, as it needs to heat the metal from cold.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "If the metal is hot when added into the blast furnace, it will take less time to reach brilliant white. Consider heating your metal in a Charcoal Forge before putting it into an already-hot furnace to save time, especially with smaller blast furnaces that process less at a time.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "You'll need lots of Steel for the Steam and LV ages. Lots of steel. The Electric Blast Furnace is far off, so maybe think about optimizing your steel production.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "You can pump liquid directly out of the blast furnace using a Create Mechanical Pump. Pump into a Mold Table and extract the ingots with a hopper or chute: Easy automation! You can automate the bellows with a Deployer too! Just be careful, as using the bellows excessively consumes more fuel and breaks your tuyere faster. You can process the resulting Pig Iron and High Carbon Steel in a Forge Hammer or Helve Hammer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips.json",
          "text": "You can automatically replace broken tuyeres with a hopper or item pipe facing into the blast furnace.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Blast Furnace Tips",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 7
        }
      ],
      "aliases": []
    },

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/bloomery.json",
          "text": "The Bloomery is a device used to smelt Iron Ore into Iron Blooms which can be worked into Wrought Iron. Some common iron ores are Hematite, Limonite, and Magnetite. These ores melt into Cast Iron rather than Wrought Iron. All iron-bearing items melt into Cast Iron. To turn them into usable iron, the bloomery is needed. Any iron item can be used in the bloomery, including iron tools and cast iron ingots!",

          "label": "Bloomery",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 10
        },

          "text": "The bloomery is made from 8 Bronze Double Plates.",

          "text": "The bloomery can contain up to a maximum of 48 Inputs, with 16 items per layer of the chimney. To add layers to the chimney, stack up two more layers of stone blocks. To add items to the bloomery, climb up to the top and throw items inside. A tower of grey ore should form. You can use both Charcoal and Coal as fuel for your bloomery.",

          "label": "Bloomery",

          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 10
        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/bloomery.json",
          "text": "The bloomery consumes 1 item of Fuel and 144 mB of Cast Iron to produce one Bloom.",

          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,

          "text": "If you don't want to do the math, we recommend 25 metal ore dusts and 22 fuel items.           "text": "The Charcoal Forge is a device used to heat and melt items. Forges are necessary to make a crucible work.           "text": "A complete forge multiblock, ready to be lit.",

          "text": "A Forge needs a chimney in order to work. The block directly above the Forge must be air, or a Crucible. In addition, either the block directly above, or one of eight nearby blocks must be able to see the sky - the blue stained glass in the visualization to the right. A Bellows can be placed on one block up and adjacent to the Forge, in order to increase the maximum temperature it can reach.",

        {

          "text": "The five slots at the bottom of the forge are used for fuel. While the forge is running, it periodically consumes fuel, which can be Charcoal or Coal. The top five slots will heat items, up to the temperature shown in the indicator on the left. The right side slots are for containers that can contain liquid metal, like Vessels and Molds.           "text": "A Crucible is an advanced device used for the creation of Alloys. It is a more precise method than using a Small Vessel to make alloys. To obtain a crucible, you will first need to obtain some Fire Clay, which is a stronger material than clay. This fire clay can then be knapped to shape it into an Unfired Crucible.",

          "label": "Crucible",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 8
        },
        {

          "text": "Knapping an Unfired Crucible.",

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/crucible.json",
          "text": "After the crucible is knapped, it will need to be fired, like any piece of pottery - a Pit Kiln or Charcoal Forge would do. In order to use the crucible, it needs a source of heat. The crucible can be heated by any heatable block below, usually a Charcoal Forge",

          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Crucible",

          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 8
        },
        {

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/crucible.json",
          "text": "Now, you are ready to use the crucible. When you use it, you will see the Crucible Interface, shown to the right. The top region shows the current metal content of the crucible. The first metal shown is what would be produced, if it were to be extracted right now. Other metals shown are the makeup of the current alloy in the crucible.",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "The crucible has nine slots where items can be added to be melted, and their liquefied contents will be directly added to the crucible. Molten metal containers such as Molds can also be placed here and they will be slowly drained into the crucible, allowing for precise control over your alloy's content. Holding while hovering over a draining mold or vessel makes it drain faster. Molds or other fluid containers can also be placed in the output slot, and will be slowly filled with the current content of the crucible.",

Metal can be extracted from the crucible as long as it is still molten. Finally, the crucible will keep its contents when broken, allowing you to transport the alloy container around if you wish.",

        {

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "Pits of Fire",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "Fire is an important technological advancement. In order to create fire, you will need a Firestarter. In order to use, simply hold down on the ground. After a few moments, smoke, and then fire will be created. It may take a couple tries to light successfully.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "Crafting a firestarter can be done with two sticks.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "With a firestarter, it is now possible to make a Firepit. In order to make one, you will need one log, three sticks, and optionally up to five pieces of kindling. Kindling can be items such as paper products, straw, or pinecones, and will increase the chance of successfully creating a firepit by 10 percent per item used. Throw () all the items on the ground, on the same block. Then use the firestarter on the block with the items floating above it.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "If you were successful, a firepit will be created.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "Using the firepit will now open the firepit screen. On the left are four fuel slots. Logs, Peat, and Stick Bundles can all be used as firepit fuel by placing them in the topmost slot. Fuel will be consumed from the bottommost slot. There is a gauge which displays the current Temperature of the firepit, and on the right, a slot for items to be heated in.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "The Firepit Screen",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "Many useful items can be made in a firepit by heating them. Sticks can be heated, where they will produce two Torches. Note that torches will eventually burn out, and need to be re-lit by using a Firestarter, or using another Torch on them.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "The fire pit is also a good device for cooking food. All raw meats and doughs can be cooked in a firepit, which will lengthen their shelf life. (More on that here)",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "The firepit can be extinguished at any time by using a Shovel on it. A firepit can also have other devices added to it to extend its functionality. Using a Wrought Iron Grill will convert the firepit into a Grill, and using a Ceramic Pot will convert the firepit into a Pot. To remove either device, while holding . Be careful not to try to remove a hot grill or pot!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",
          "item_ref_count": 11,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 11
        },
        {

          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/getting_started/firepit.json",
          "text": "A firepit, with either a grill or pot added.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Pits of Fire",

          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
